ca_pal.text: Outside Quebec: in most cases you must accept your offer and pay tuition, in part or in full, to get your PAL/TAL.
ca_pal.evidence: In most cases, you need to accept your offer and pay your tuition fees, either in part or in full, to get your PAL/TAL." (IRCC, dated 2026-10-06: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/study-permit/get-documents.html) [page]

ca_permit_applied.text: Outside Quebec, IRCC's living-cost figure is CAD 23,448 per year for one applicant (applications from 1 Sep 2026), plus tuition and travel.
ca_permit_applied.evidence: IRCC living-cost figure for one applicant (outside Quebec), apply on/after Sept 1, 2026 | CAD 23,448 per year, excl. tuition and travel | IRCC 2026-08-28 [page]

ca_permit_applied.text: No medical exam is needed for Taiwan on IRCC's country list, unless you lived 6+ months in a listed country in the year before.
ca_permit_applied.evidence: Medical exam: needed for a stay over 6 months if the applicant lived or travelled 6 months or more in a row in the year before coming in "certain countries or territories", or for protected jobs. **Taiwan (Republic of China): "no"**, row marked "New: As of November 3, 2025" on IRCC's country list (https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/application/medical-police/medical-exams/requirements-temporary-residents/country-requirements.html, fetched 2026-11-04; requirements page dated 2026-08-04) [page]

ca_biometrics.text: Biometrics cost CAD 85 per person (maximum CAD 170 per family). Give them within 30 days of the biometrics letter.
ca_biometrics.evidence: CAD **85** per person (maximum CAD 170 per family); give them within **30 days** of the biometrics letter; processing starts after biometrics are received. (IRCC apply page, dated 2026-09-02: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/study-permit/apply.html) [page]

ca_deposit.text: UBC deposit: CAD 3,000 when you accept the offer.

ca_pal.text: Quebec: you need a CAQ instead of a PAL. Apply for it as soon as you get your admission letter, then apply for the permit once the CAQ letter arrives.
ca_pal.evidence: Quebec students need a CAQ (attestation) instead of a PAL. Sequence: get admitted -> apply for the CAQ "as soon as you receive your letter of admission" -> apply for the federal permit "as soon as you receive the letter confirming your CAQ". (quebec.ca, last update Oct 22, 2026: https://www.quebec.ca/en/education/study-quebec/obtaining-authorizations/authorizations) [page]

ca_permit_applied.text: Quebec financial capacity for the CAQ: CAD 24,617 living costs per year (applications from 1 Jan 2026), plus tuition and round-trip transport.
ca_permit_applied.evidence: living costs CAD **24,617** per year for a single adult for applications as of Jan 1, 2026, plus tuition and round-trip transport shown separately. (quebec.ca, last update Jan 1, 2026: https://www.quebec.ca/en/education/study-quebec/required-conditions/costs-studies) [page]
